newsitem.title: USA: Merry Land sees $0.5 mln gain from sale.
newsitem.headline: Merry Land sees $0.5 mln gain from sale.

text.p: Merry Land said it sold Sawmill Village Apartments, a 340-unit apartment community in Columbus, Ohio, to Associated Estates Realty Corp for $19.6 million and will recognize a gain of $0.5 million from the transaction.
The company said that proceeds from the sale will be used for the acquisition and development of luxury apartment communities in the company's Southern markets.

Merry Land's President, Tennent Houston, said location of the Ohio community, which the company acquired in 1994 as part of a twelve-property portfolio transaction, did not fit in with the company's strategy of building on its franchise as the largest owner of high quality apartments in the South.
Houston said, another community, located in Cleveland, Ohio and acquired in the same portfolio transaction, was sold in December 1996.
Merry Land is an apartment operating company that has elected Real Estate Investment Trust tax status.
